name: The Forum Build
pitch: Six arts that pass the lint fire at the first pulse without waiting, because you bought a 200-year field: a Nascent Soul kills a Deity at t = 1 for no seasons at all.

new.name: Title Deed
new.effect: While a formation you hold title to stands, your arts with an authored cooldown of 6 s or more count as carrying the formation source tag. Sold with the formation.
new.second_home: any sect elder on a home array; any long art on old ground

questions: The lint is a check on a record: this volley fires 43.1 against 11.9 sold and reads within. Adopt 'a wait is paid, never deleted', with Standing Water as a pool? It changes none of the three parent builds.
Making a Flat base count against the lint is the obvious fix and the worst: it kills Level Ground and Fortieth Breath and this build still beats a Deity. Rule it out?
Should a one-realm-up win stay possible at 63 seasons a fight, or should the 'served' repair end it, at a cost to Already-Waited?
Should Old Bund read the holder's years, not the formation's?
